neutral.caption: Well done! You are at the beginning of becoming truly strong, probably, if ambition guides you through this small transformation: a great Atlantic salmon in the making!

medium.caption: Well done! You are at the beginning of becoming truly strong, probably, if ambition guides you through this small transformation: a great Atlantic salmon in the making!

high.title: Baby salmon
high.caption: You are a salmon fry: you have managed to hatch. Not bad at all, but you will need courage to make it all the way. Hold on, we need salmon like you.
